name: self_improve
description: Spawn an external coding agent (Claude Code or OpenCode) to investigate and modify the OS source code. The agent works autonomously in /usr/src/levsha/, reading, searching, editing files, and running tests. Its progress streams in real-time to the split-view panel. Use this tool when the user requests a code change, bug fix, UI modification, or any source-level improvement.

prompt.description: A detailed description of the change to make. Include the user's original request and any relevant context about which component to modify (chat-shell, engine, skills, config).

target_component.description: Which component the change primarily targets. Use 'auto' to let the agent determine the scope. Default: auto.
